headline: Malawi Secures $222 Million World Bank Financing Package
summary: Malawi secured $221.9 million in World Bank-backed funding to support exporters and direct cash transfer initiatives. The World Bank reiterated that economic structural reforms are vital to create sustainable jobs.
why: The World Bank provides financial development assistance, loans, and grants to lower-income nations.

impacts.name: Malawi
impacts.why: Multilateral aid funds boost foreign reserve levels and support state social assistance programs.
